name: Claude's picks
rules: Copies my AI picks list for coins: up to 10 coins, at most 3 per category, ranked by relative strength among liquid coins (the IBD formula: 40% weight on the last 3 months, 20% each on 6, 9 and 12).
Trades at about 10:00 New York time, every day: sells coins that left the list the night before and buys the new ones, about a tenth of the account each. Empty spots stay in cash.

Your overbought rule: it doesn't buy anything with RSI over 70 or CCI over 100 (checked on the live price when it buys), or while the market's breadth or the coin's category's is over the 75 line (the share of its coins with the 10 EMA over the 20, last night).
A pick it skipped for being overbought is bought later, once it isn't, while it's still on the list.
A coin stays while it ranks in the top 20. No stop-loss, as in the stock version.
The stock version of this list was tested on S&P 500 stocks (2014-2026); it has not been tested on coins, which swing much harder.
fills: Paper trades, no real money. Coins fill at Yahoo's latest 1-minute price, 0.05% worse, and fractions of a coin are allowed. No exchange fee is charged; real exchanges charge about 0.1% to 0.6% a trade.
